region_selection: Fixed 3 km by 3 km subset of northern Key West basin visible in paper Fig.5; selected geographically before retrieving or evaluating depth predictions. Exact authors' ROI not published.

reference.conversion: NOAA VDatum spatial correction; requests and interpolation check retained
limitations: Public survey sensor label differs from main paper; exact source identity unresolved.
Official 1 m DEM interpolates classified ground and seabed returns; return counts unavailable.
Lidar and satellite acquisition are separated by approximately ten months.

evaluation.split: fixed checkerboard spatial blocks with excluded boundary pixels; calibration and evaluation never share source reference cells
evaluation.baseline: calibration-block mean depth on held-out blocks
evaluation.selection_rule: Report every registered correction and model variant; no selection or calibration using held-out errors.

interpretation_limits: Reconstruction using current pinned ACOLITE and reprocessed Sentinel L1C, not bitwise reproduction of historical processing.
Main paper's nine chart calibration points are unavailable; fixed published coefficients and spatially held-out lidar recalibration are reported separately.
Published accuracy is contextual because region, baseline, calibration and source provenance differ; it is not an automatic acceptance threshold.
This experiment evaluates the SDB component only; it does not validate attenuation, effective bottom reflectance, detectability or PAR.
